scrutiny_call_in.exact_phrasing: A call-in must be requested within three working days of the decision being published on the Council's website (not including the day of publication). If the member is not on the relevant scrutiny committee, the call-in must be supported by other members or the Scrutiny Committee.

key_constitutional_quirks: FIRST Conservative-to-Reform flip — Tory for 25 years prior. Reform +29 majority.
HIGHEST LEADER SRA in cohort at £61,787 (basic £14,471 × 4.5).
Essex Fire under PFCC since 2017 — NO Fire Authority SRA stream (unusual deprivation vs metropolitan unitaries).
ECC administers its own pension fund — pension committee work is INTERNAL.
Reform UK cllr quit DAYS after election over alleged racist posts — slim margin matters.
CALL-IN DEADLINE = 3 WORKING DAYS — tightest in cohort.

first_action_checklist: Leader and Deputy Leader confirmed at Annual Council Meeting (2026-05-28).
Cabinet portfolios announced — ESPECIALLY the SEND lead who owns the 19 June 2026 HNSG Reform Plan submission.
Outside body appointments — prioritise the SRA-paying bodies (Fire / Pension / Combined Authority / PCP) since these reward members beyond the council's own allowances pot.
Audit Committee chair confirmed — note convention in some councils that opposition chairs.
Scrutiny chairs confirmed — Reform group retains call-in/Q&A leverage even where opposition gets a chair.
Brief Group Whip on motion submission deadlines (working-days calc per Standing Orders) BEFORE the first post-AGM Full Council.
Confirm Cabinet diary for first 100 days.
